fields.name: Name (a-z, 0-9, dash; 1-64; permanent)
fields.maxBudget: Max budget (USD per run; empty = unlimited)
fields.bareToggle: Skip hooks, plugin sync, attribution, auto-memory, keychain reads, CLAUDE.md auto-discovery
fields.runAs: Run as (account email; empty = active account)
fields.taskBudget: Task budget (tokens per run; empty = no ceiling)
fields.rateMin: Rate limit — minimum seconds between runs (optional)
fields.rateMax: Rate limit — maximum runs per day (optional)
fields.debounce: Debounce — seconds of session inactivity before firing

hints.cwd: CC discovers .claude (commands, agents, skills) from cwd up to git-root. Set this to your project root for slash-commands to work.
hints.binaryLocked: Binary cannot change in edit mode — the scheduler registration and helper shim are tied to the original binary. Delete and re-create to switch.
hints.permissionMode: Unattended runs typically need bypassPermissions with a tight allowed-tools whitelist below.
hints.disallowedTools: Prefer the allowed-tools whitelist above. Use this only to carve specific tools out of an otherwise broad grant.
hints.mcp: Attaching Claudepot memory passes a stdio MCP server running `claudepot mcp memory-server` to the agent. Custom MCP servers carried on this agent are preserved but not editable here.
hints.runAs: Phase 1 records this but still runs as the CLI-active account; per-run credential pinning lands in a later release.
hints.lifecycle: Read-only. A draft is inert until armed; the GUI Add Agent flow arms agents on create.
hints.triggerCron: Five-field cron expression; an IANA timezone is optional.
hints.triggerEvent: Fires when a CC session in this agent's cwd has been idle for the debounce window. Requires a rate-limit (set below) to bound cost.
hints.triggerManual: No scheduler artifact is created. The agent only runs when you click Run Now.
hints.debounceDefault: Default {{secs}}s (10 min). A session quiet for this long has almost certainly ended.

errors.budget: Budget must be a finite non-negative number.
errors.taskBudget: Task budget must be a positive whole number of tokens.
errors.rateMin: Minimum interval must be a positive whole number of seconds.
errors.rateMax: Maximum runs per day must be a positive whole number.
errors.debounce: Debounce must be a positive whole number of seconds.
errors.eventNeedsRateLimit: Event-triggered agents must carry a rate-limit (above): set a minimum interval and/or a maximum runs-per-day. Without one, a busy project could fire dozens of billed runs an hour.

platform.wake: Wake the computer to run this
platform.catchUp: Catch up if a run was missed

cron.label: Cron expression (5 fields: min hour dom mon dow)

template.title: Add {{name}} draft
template.body: Creates a {{name}} draft. The agent is inert until you review and install it. Pick the project directory the narrator should watch — the `session-settled` trigger only fires for sessions inside this path.

review.title: Review & install {{name}}
review.intro: This agent is a draft. Installing it arms the agent — Claudepot will materialize a scheduler artifact and the agent can run unattended. Review the spec below before you install.
review.introDrafted: This agent is a draft (drafted by {{name}}). Installing it arms the agent — Claudepot will materialize a scheduler artifact and the agent can run unattended. Review the spec below before you install.

origin.bodyCli: This record was produced by the AI-drafting CLI verb, not by the Add Agent form. The `drafted_by` value above is advisory and can be set by the caller — scrutinize the prompt, working directory, MCP servers, and allowed-tools list below before arming.
origin.bodyTemplate: This record was produced by the built-in template flow, not by the Add Agent form. The `drafted_by` value above is advisory and can be set by the caller — scrutinize the prompt, working directory, MCP servers, and allowed-tools list below before arming.

review.bypassBody: This agent runs with permission prompts disabled. Installing it consents to an unattended, elevated run scoped only by the allowed-tools whitelist below. Make sure that list is tight.

values.runAsWarning: Per-run credential injection is not yet wired — this run will use whichever account is CLI-active at fire time, not the pinned email above.
